Resolves #21939
Related: #21140, #21346, #21706, #21936, neomjs/pages#177

Keeps all six planning example headers (`gantt/bigData`, `gantt/dependencies`, `gantt/cascade`, `scheduler/dragAndResize`, `scheduler/zoom`, `scheduler/resourceColumns`) in one piece at `960 × 540`—grouping `[Days | Weeks]` in `gantt/bigData`, restoring `flex: 1` on `gantt/dependencies`'s `.launch-status`, and wrapping hints/legends below row 1—and opens `gantt/zoom` on its `Month` preset so the opening frame shows the plan's staircase rather than three bars.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium E2E across all 7 examples × 3 sizes + live dark/light cover switch + two-reader cold visual critique; companion `neomjs/pages#177` merged at `f3a679a0` and AC-7 look passed by `@neo-fable-clio`) → L3 required (#21939 AC-1..AC-8).

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline PR baseline, guards, Skills materialized ran.
